title: Smart RTP+TPA Plugin
description: Safe RTP + TPA plugin with GUI confirmations, cooldowns, and world-border safe teleports for Paper 1.21+.
body:
Smart RTP+TPA is a Paper plugin for safe random teleport and player-to-player teleports with GUI confirmations.

Key features:
- Safe RTP with world-border checks + dimension GUI (Overworld/Nether/End)
- TPA / TPAHere with dual confirmation GUI
- Configurable cooldowns/delays and effects (sounds/particles/titles)
- Admin teleports + offline last-location support

Commands:
Player: /rtp, /tpa <player>, /tpahere <player>, /tpaccept <player>, /tpdeny <player>
Admin: /tpo <player>, /tpohere <player>, /tplast <player>, /tpoffline <player>

Permissions:
smartrtp.use, smartrtp.tpa, smartrtp.tpahere, smartrtp.admin, smartrtp.bypass.cooldown
